notes.title: Celebrating 8 Years Since the International Steam release of Symphonic Rain!
notes.content: [p]Originally released in 2004, KOGADO Studio's masterpiece Symphonic Rain was released internationally for the first time 8 years ago today![/p][p]Adored by fans for its deeply emotional and well-crafted narrative, memorable music, and strong character development ( 96% Overwhelmingly Positive on Steam!), Symphonic Rain combines the exquisite story writing of Maoto Nishikawa, masterful artwork of Siro, and beautiful melodies of Ritsuko Okazaki into an unforgettable masterpiece.[/p][p]Set in Piova, a city of music and endless rain, Symphonic Rain explores the story of Chris Vertin, a student at the Piova Communal School of Music as he attempts to master the magical instrument known as the Fortelle, while grappling with his own melancholy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28754622/4da1c1ce21d108412e9bd9a5f510082ef0cccf67.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Korean Language Added to Symphonic Rain
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28754622/1713c8497a289b51dc96382aea4dfeea90440391.jpg[/img]

The city of music and perpetual rain is taking the stage for a whole new audience!

We at KOGADO STUDIO and KOMODO are happy to announce that our bittersweet visual novel rhythm game Symphonic Rain has been updated to add the Korean language.

Whether you are finally able to play the game for the first time, or you are replaying it to finally experience the touching story in your native language, we hope you enjoy the performance.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/629650/Symphonic_Rain/

So if everyone could please take your seats, the music is about to begin...

notes.title: Visual Novel/Music Game, Symphonic Rain, Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28754622/264c172faf97b3a21defb2377ec101cbe7e0179a.png[/img]
[b]It's time to dust off your Fortelle and find a vocal partner because the Symphonic Rain HD Remaster is now available for purchase![/b]

Play the definitive version of the 2004 Visual Novel/Music game classic from KOGADO Studio, with visuals remastered in beautiful high-def by original character artist Siro. Also available for the first time (officially) in English!

Set in Piova, the city of music and endless rain, guide Chris Vertin on the path to become a Fortenist—a master of the magical instrument known as the Fortelle. Play music sections with different vocal partners set to the beautiful melodies composed and sung by Ritsuko Okazaki. Experience multiple endings based on your choices and performances. 

When the sound of Chris's playing harmonizes with the voice of the musical magic fairy, who knows what might happen? Play now and find out!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/629650/Symphonic_Rain/

Find more information along with messages from the staff on the official website: [url=http://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/sr2017/en/]http://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/sr2017/en/[/url]
